cuero.name: Armadura de cuero
cuero.prompt: studded brown leather armour: a ranger's outfit, hardened leather cuirass with rivets, leather bracers and shoulder guards, brown trousers, tall leather boots, no metal plates

malla.name: Cota de malla
malla.prompt: a chainmail hauberk: a long shirt of fine steel rings down to mid-thigh with chainmail sleeves, a plain dark blue cloth tabard over the chest with a thin gold border, a wide leather belt, leather gloves, padded brown trousers and leather boots; no plate armour

imperial.name: Placas imperiales
imperial.prompt: heavy imperial full plate armour: thick dark gunmetal plates with ornate gold trim and engravings, large layered pauldrons, a gold lion crest on the breastplate, armoured gauntlets, plated greaves and sabatons; bare head, same face and hair

escamas.name: Armadura de escamas de dragón
escamas.prompt: dragon-scale armour: overlapping deep crimson scales covering the torso, shoulders and thighs, blackened steel edging, spiked scale pauldrons, crimson scale bracers and greaves, dark leather straps; bare head, same face and hair
